Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Bars
Punchline: Change your hotbars depending on the user's ruleset.
Description:
Tinker with your hotbars, such as showing them when it rains but only when you're in combat!
/willobars opens the settings.
Changelog: - Wait until the game takes commands again before showing or hiding hotbars

Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Muter
Punchline: Muting certain people, emotes, crowd noises and more
Description:
Annoyed by certain people or emotes? Want to disable the yelps and whines of the ambient crowd noises? Enjoy this one~
/willomuter to open settings
Changelog:
- Save the server info bar colour once you let go of the picker
- Only draw the emotes you can see in the Emotes list
- Skip the sound checks when nobody nearby is muted, and keep them from flooding the log

Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Patchwisp
Punchline: Patch notes for your Dalamud plugins.
Description: Shows the changelogs of your Dalamud plugins when they update (falling back to GitHub releases when a plugin has none), lists and installs updates waiting in your plugin repositories, and shows the current changelog of every installed plugin. Open it with /patchwisp.
Changelog: - Read each changelog's words and links once instead of every frame
